keyFigures.tankerCrossingsDarkShareOct25to28: 32 of 38 crossings (84%) classed dark or unknown route

hormuzTotalClearance7dSplitKbd.note: edition text: 'Crude averaged 7,290 kbd of clearance over 7 days, well above the 1,172 kbd of products' — the split is of the CLEARANCE measure (7,290 + 1,172 = 8,462), not of the 7,195 strait figure

keyFigures.gulfOfOmanStsNetExportsRangeKbd: -2,979 (26 Oct) to 3,284 (27 Oct); net turns negative when STS imports exceed exports on the day
keyFigures.iraq: Basra exports recovered to 3 mbd (~300 kbd below pre-war); Kirkuk loadings from Ceyhan 420 kbd in October; total Iraqi oil exports back to pre-war levels (Kpler Insight)
keyFigures.sidiKerir: loadings near 1.5 mbd; more than half of October loadings expected to reach Asia via the Cape (~55 days)
keyFigures.saudiWestCoast: actualised loadings near 2.6 mbd in October to date, ~400 kbd lower than September (Kpler Insight, Oct 29)
keyFigures.asiaBoundViaBabElMandeb: subsided to ~250 kbd from a June peak of ~3.4 mbd
keyFigures.attacks: IMO, cited by Kpler Insight Oct 23: at least 10 attacks on VLCCs in October alone — a third of the 32 incidents recorded across the conflict
keyFigures.iranReopening: Tehran proposed shortening its Hormuz reopening plan to 4-5 days if Washington lifts the blockade (Kpler Insight)
keyFigures.sinokor: Iran has threatened legal action against Sinokor from next week; Sinokor carries nearly 40% of Hormuz crude (Kpler Insight)

reconciliation.vsOct19Edition: same measures, same definitions (oil only: Crude/Co, CPP, DPP, Chem/Bio; excludes NGLs/LNG; Iranian-origin transits excluded from strait figures only; pre-war baseline = average March 2025 - February 2026). Strait 7-day avg 7,894 (data to Oct 17) -> 7,195 (data to Oct 28); baseline 17,267 -> 17,147 (edition baseline refresh, same window); Total Hormuz Clearance 10,173 -> 8,462; tanker crossings 10/day -> 11/day (latest day 8); Red Sea 7-day avg 4,304 -> 3,017 (STS cargo dated by the day it surfaces, recent days preliminary and revise upward); Fujairah/Oman loadings 4,563 -> 4,634
reconciliation.vsOct30WirePrints: CNBC (Oct 30): 'flows decline to 7.3 million bpd for the week ended Wednesday [Oct 28]' = the edition's CRUDE component of Total Hormuz Clearance (7,290 kbd of clearance, vs 1,172 kbd products), a crude-flow measure — NOT the strait-transit total-oil measure (7,195 kbd) the site's map labels and model --volume channel use. 'More than 40% below the prewar baseline' is consistent with the shared 17,147 kbd baseline (7,290 is 57.5% below it). Do not mix the two measures.
